'''Aur IX''' was a spherical [[Diamond/Legends|diamond]] the size of a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|world]]. It occupied the ninth [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position in the<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies']]<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Aur system/Legends|Aur system]]. The diamond was believed to have at some point formed the core of a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]]&ndash;type planet, and the creation of the free-floating sphere was widely attributed to members of the [[Celestial/Legends|Celestial]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="Author's Cut" /> which had disappeared from [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by [[30,000 BBY]].<ref name="30,000 BBY" /> Aur IX, [[Aur X]]&mdash;a similar spherical object in the Aur [[Star system/Legends|system's]] tenth orbit&mdash;and the [[Aur system diamond cloud|cloud]] of diamond fragments occupying the eleventh orbit were collectively known as the [[Aur Diamonds]].<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Behind the scenes==
Aur IX was originally meant to be mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however, the sidebar that would have mentioned the diamond was cut before the book's release. The information regarding the object was later released in [[2013]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and [[Del Rey]] editor [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="Author's Cut" />
